comments.author: Marco Reyes
comments.body: Reopened after prod: two agents on ticket NMS-55210 both hit autosave within the same second; one paragraph still vanished. 409 path is not wired for the poll path, only for explicit save.

content.text: Reopened after prod: two agents on ticket NMS-55210 both hit autosave within the same second; one paragraph still vanished. 409 path is not wired for the poll path, only for explicit save.

When two agents open the same support reply draft, autosave from agent A overwrites agent B's newer keystrokes without merge or conflict UI. Last writer before the 8-second autosave interval wins; the other agent's paragraph disappears on next poll.

Expected: either operational transform / CRDT merge, or a conflict banner when revision tokens diverge. Actual: PUT /drafts/{id} is last-write-wins with no If-Match check, and the client blindly replaces local state with the server body on poll.
Hypothesis: revision field exists on the draft row but neither the autosave client nor the API enforces it. Concurrent edits during shift overlap (common on Sev-1 threads) silently drop text.
Already lost a carefully worded legal reply once; agent had to reconstruct from memory.
